prompt: A factory creates a negative production externality. Which condition would make an indirect tax most closely internalise the external cost?

options.label: B

options.label: C
options.text: Tax per unit equals MSC at the market equilibrium.

options.label: D

prompt: A tax on a negative consumption externality is set above the marginal external cost. Which outcome is most likely?
